# Migration baselines

The four resource manifests capture the TypeScript program from commit fb232de,
with AWS 7.44.0, Cloudflare 6.20.0, Random 4.21.1 and Pulumi 3.261.0 mocked SDKs.
They contain synthetic identifiers and secrets only. Scenarios cover foundation,
legacy, transition (both hosts and fleet), and rolling-only mode. All deployed
resource types, logical names and input values are compared with the Go program.
JSON policy object ordering and secret-envelope representation are normalized;
array order and generated user data are compared exactly.

`legacy.sh` and `rolling.sh` are exact output bytes from the original TypeScript
bootstrap function, including its JSON property order. They are test fixtures,
not scripts to execute on hosts. Go tests parse their shell/Python programs and
compare generated bytes so a language-only change cannot trigger a host refresh.

Keep these baselines fixed for the migration. Future intentional infrastructure
changes should update corresponding expectations with a reviewed explanation.
